name: complex
description: Demo database for complex types in Trino. One table with one column per type shape.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.label: Tags
attributes.description: List of text values; elements are addressed 1-based

attributes.name: scores
attributes.label: Scores
attributes.description: List of integers; numeric elements for lambda arithmetic

attributes.name: vec
attributes.label: Vector
attributes.description: Array of three doubles; Trino has no fixed-size array

attributes.name: matrix
attributes.label: Matrix
attributes.description: Array of two arrays of three doubles: the first index selects the row

attributes.name: dims
attributes.label: Dimensions
attributes.description: Flat row (struct) of width and height

attributes.name: address
attributes.label: Address
attributes.description: Row holding a nested row (geo) and an array (phones)

attributes.name: attrs
attributes.label: Attributes
attributes.description: Map from text keys to text values

attributes.name: counts
attributes.label: Counts
attributes.description: Map from text keys to integer values

attributes.name: lookup
attributes.label: Lookup
attributes.description: Map with integer keys: a numeric selector is a key here, a position in a list

attributes.name: items
attributes.label: Items
attributes.description: List of order-line-like structs: sku, quantity, price and a list of options

attributes.name: events
attributes.label: Events
attributes.description: List of structs with temporal fields

attributes.name: deep
attributes.label: Deep
attributes.description: Four levels: a list of maps whose values are structs holding a list and a map of lists

attributes.name: doc
attributes.label: Document
attributes.description: JSON document; JSON paths count from 0, selectors count from 1

attributes.name: odd
attributes.label: Odd
attributes.description: Row with a mixed-case field name that needs quoting

links.name: same_check
links.comment: both tables refer to the same data record
